scope: Offline B1 text with German and English meanings. Final sign-off by separate Codex readers.

lessonsRead.observation: The opening establishes a morning habit. Aron supplies the purpose, and the return invitation uses kung to set the condition for an evening run. Both translations preserve the distinction. The single-string form cues in this path use English labels after the Cebuano root, as in the specification’s example.
The coworker combines the weekend market and beach plans. Plano nga states intent, and only kung introduces the proposed condition in the visible options.
The coach proposes a shorter distance and the reply agrees to time three kilometres. Inig Disyembre frames December as the goal date; “by December” is a contextual rendering.
The stated rent condition leads to an added cleaning fee and a counterproposal. The exercise reconstructs staying next month if the tenant cleans.
The clerk asks for the bicycle earlier. The speaker offers five today if the rain stops. The German captures the nuance of ugma pa more explicitly than the English.
The twice-weekly condition meets the tutor’s once-weekly limit; studying at home on Thursday is a workable response. The choices distinguish home study from class.
Para sa biyahe identifies what the savings are for. A cheaper dinner becomes acceptable if the two share the bill; the Cebuano and both translations align.
The travel agent’s lower May fare motivates the switch from June. The learner’s final sentence uses a visible purpose choice and the date remains unambiguous.
The wedding explains the leave request. In a polite question the learner names Thursday and Friday, as the boss requested two days. The weekday and attendance choices fit.
The cousins combine the island and mountain trips by spending the night in the mountains on returning. Inig balik connects the two parts in the reconstructed sentence.
The evening-run compromise now tests Modagan, ugma and kung; every offered time and connector foil fails in this context.
The market-and-beach compromise tests a future verb, a real alternative destination and a condition. The term list now includes mouban, the verb the learner actually uses.
The coach gets a measurable December goal and three-kilometre trial. The exercise separates future Modagan, a weekday and purpose aron; inig is a valid temporal speech anchor.
The tenant's condition now explicitly specifies doing the cleaning with no extra fee, leaving the landlady able to agree or decline.
The rental clerk asks for today's return. Karong alas singko makes the compromise explicit and kung is now an apt speech anchor.
The tutor's one class leads to home study on Thursday. The future, condition and weekday are all assessed with a single offered answer.
The friend's inexpensive meal leads to a cost split; mouban / kung / bayad independently reconstruct the proposal.
The agent's cheaper May fare prompts a matching month, future departure and purpose of saving. The learner commits only to the travel plan.

The manager receives an appropriately polite Sige, apan counteroffer and the cloze includes cued makatambong. Nga, which links the cousin to the identifying phrase si Rosa, now supplies the required connective speech word on the unchanged first reply.
The cousin combines island and mountain plans. The form, mountain alternative and inig timing link have distinct offered answers. Both locales agree when the overnight stay occurs.
The runner gives a purpose and makes the friend's evening run conditional on a lit park. Both first-person and inclusive forms fit their turns.
The coworker suggests the nearby market; breakfast then a walk to the sea combines both plans. Weekend weather and the date agree across translations.
The coach, five-kilometre goal and shorter trial are convincing. Inig Disyembre is rendered both as 'in December' and 'by December' across the same episode.
The landlady adds a weekly cleaning charge and the learner proposes self-cleaning rather than claiming a fee waiver. The transfer example applies the condition to work.
The clerk asks about returning the bike. Bare balik is a noun with a time, and five o'clock is an appropriate conditional compromise. No learner request needs palihug here.
The tutor offers one teaching day and home study is a plausible response. The recurring classes and inclusive ta are anchored by the other participant.
The friend offers to share a dish and the learner conditionally accepts splitting the cost. Tigom as savings works in both the dialogue and transfer.
The agent offers May after the traveller specifies June. The Bohol ferry, changing fare, and final week of May are grounded without the learner asserting a ticketing decision.
The supervisor asks for two days and the learner politely proposes Thursday and Friday with palihug. The speech target and late-stage compromise construction need attention.
The cousin proposes the mountains; the learner folds them into the return from the island. Un­ta stays on the partner's side, but 'magpalabay tag gabii' is a circuitous model for staying overnight.

findings.issue: P7 specifies a single-fit purpose/condition/reason connector, whole future form, and a choice on time/alternative. All ten final replies test only two slots. The connectors are coded choice; L2 tests dayon instead of the path connector, L8/L10 have no connector, and L9 has neither a future-form blank nor a connector.
findings.recommendation: Bring the set into the P7 design with genuine connector/form/time-or-alternative choices, adjusting replies where needed. Keep each response a natural compromise; check all alternatives in the resulting sentence.

findings.issue: The early-stage transfer example includes para sa among panihapon, but para + noun purpose is reserved for recognition in them-lines in L1–3.
findings.recommendation: Use a simple time or meal detail without a purpose noun phrase in this early transfer example.

findings.issue: The spec's 'by December' deadline is rendered in the main answer as merely running 'in December', while the identical target fragment gets 'by December' in the chip. The speech targets are tumong, pagdagan (a verbal noun), kilometro; none is a connector or aspect-bearing verb.
findings.recommendation: Give the December phrase one clearly supported deadline meaning across both bases and the chip. Anchor speech to a connector such as inig or to an inflected verb in a revised answer.

findings.issue: Ugma (tomorrow), balik (here a noun), and bisikleta (bicycle) do not cover the required connector/aspect-bearing word.
findings.recommendation: Use kung from the same line instead of ugma or bisikleta.

findings.issue: All four compromise beats are present, but the late-stage productive Sige, apan + alternative never appears in any learner answer; all four accept without explicitly practising the required contrast.
findings.recommendation: Give at least one late-stage compromise a natural Sige, apan ... qualification, e.g. on sharing the dinner bill or proposing leave dates.

findings.issue: Hinungdan, hangyo and kasal are all nouns in this sentence. The three anchors do not include the specified connector or aspect-bearing word.
findings.recommendation: Include a meaningful connector or aspect-bearing verb in the first learner reply and select it as an anchor.

findings.issue: May gabii pa ta is a strained way to count a spare night, and magpalabay tag gabii focuses on letting a night pass. The English final reply says 'on our way back' whereas inig balik and the German refer to return.
findings.recommendation: Use a natural count such as Naa pa tay usa ka gabii and an overnight verb such as magpalabay only if explicitly teaching 'let the night pass'; otherwise use matulog/magpalabay with a clear intended sense, or magpalabay → magpabilin/mag-overnight phrasing with a count. Align the timing in German and English.

lessonsRead.observation: Friend scene matches beat (early run → evening counter-offer → tomorrow-evening compromise). youOne 15 words with trophy aron, tokens mobangon/aron/makadagan, chunks join exactly; aron + makadagan clause is the first model, pattern transfer (aron makaabot ko sa pantalan) is distinct. Cloze foils (Nidagan/Gidagan/Pagdagan; hangtod sa/tungod sa/gikan) are impossible in slot; cue does not contain the answer. kung in youTwo is A2 P3 recycle, acceptable before block 4–6. DE/EN idiomatic and aspect-matched.

Coworker beat honored; youOne 12 words with plano nga + moadto + kung condition, youTwo combines market breakfast then walk to sea. Cloze Mopalit/dayon sound. One orthography slip in the them-line: 'Dool' where this path and A2 use 'duol' (lesson 7 foil 'duol sa'); fix for spelling consistency.

Coach beat honored; tumong anchored as noun in youOne and example. Three issues: them-line 'Kumusta kung tulo lang una?' is an English 'how about' calque, native is 'Unsa kaha kung'; full-line DE/EN say 'im Dezember / in December' while chunks say 'bis Dezember / by December' (beat says 'by December'); pattern example 2 uses unanchored English loan 'buoy' instead of Cebuano 'boya'. Cloze Modagan/aron foils fine.

Landlady scene stays informal per outline (not a listed service exception). umaabot nga bulan + kung dili mosaka correct (dili before future mosaka); youTwo negotiates without asserting staff decision ('mahimo bang walay dugang bayad?'). Choice blank Kung vs Gikan sa/Sulod sa/Tungod sa impossible in slot; form cue justifies molimpyo over nilimpyo. Clean.

Service scene (clerk) kept neutral; balik anchored as bare noun predicate 'ang akong balik' in youOne and example, mobalik productive in youTwo. 14/9 words, tokens hyphen-free, chunks join. Cloze Mobalik/kung foils ungrammatical in slot. 'Am Montag kommt die Person …' is stilted but gender-safe; not changing.

Tutor beat honored; 'Padayon ang akong pagtuon' bare stative predicate anchors trophy, kaduha sa usa ka semana frequency, youTwo 'wala tay klase' uses correct fused tay and wala + existential. Cloze Magtuon (Nagtuon foil = progressive, impossible after kung future) and kung foils fine. Recall fallbacks fine.

Friend scene; tigom para sa productive per block 7–10, 'mokaon lang ko' clitic order attested, youTwo 'Sige, mouban ko kung magbahin ta' is the staged sige compromise. Form-blank foil 'pag-uban' is the only hyphenated cloze choice in the path (all other lessons use hyphen-free foils); replace with 'nakauban' to keep hyphens out of exercise surfaces.

Service (agent) scene; biyahe + month + paingon sa, 'kung moubos ang plete' correct. youTwo accepts with 'Sige'. Choice blank 'kataposang semana sa ___': foil 'Bohol' is grammatical and contextually plausible ('my last week in Bohol'), violating the impossible-foil rule; replace with 'plete'. Recall and pattern fine.

Service (boss) scene; hinungdan sa + mao ang kasal, palihug on the request line, 'Mahimo bang … lang' avoids asserting approval. 16-word youOne at limit, ig-agaw hyphen only in dialogue. Full-line DE/EN recast the sentence as 'weil/because', hiding the taught 'Grund/reason' frame while the chunks gloss 'Der Grund für meinen Antrag'; align translations to the literal structure. Two-choice cloze lacks a form blank but is within 2–3 blanks.

Cousin friend scene recycles kung (P3/L4–6), inig balik (L5), sige compromise (L7–8) and inclusive ta/atong; unta appears only in the them-line. youTwo 11 words. Choice blank 'sa ___ inig balik gikan sa isla': foils 'Biyernes' and 'Hunyo' are grammatical and plausible time phrases, not impossible; replace with clearly impossible nouns. Form blank magpalabay fine.

lessonsRead.observation: Friend scene holds: purpose with aron in the first reply, inclusive ta in the evening compromise, clitics in attested order (Gabii lang ta, Mobangon ko og sayo). Speech trio mobangon/aron/makadagan has noun-verb plus connector. Cloze foils (Nidagan/Gidagan/Pagdagan; hangtod sa/tungod sa/gikan) are all impossible in slot. The kung blank is correctly coded 'choice', not typed 'connector': basta and kon would fit a typed slot and be unjustly rejected, so the counterpart's path-wide HIGH on kind coding is not adopted.

Coworker beat, Duol spelling and the breakfast-then-beach combination read natively; dayon is rightly a choice blank (unya would fit a typed slot). One staging slip: the transfer example 'magluto og isda para sa among panihapon' models para + noun purpose productively, which lessons 1-3 reserve for recognition in them-lines.

Earlier fixes are present (Unsa kaha kung, boya, bis Dezember/by December consistent across line, chunk and example). Speech trio tumong/pagdagan/kilometro has no connector or aspect-bearing word; inig from the same line supplies it in canonical order.

Landlady exchange is a genuine negotiation: fee added, learner requests a waiver via mahimo bang rather than asserting it. Kung/molimpyo blanks are single-fit among their foils and the cue keeps nilimpyo out; umaabot nga bulan/semana transfer is distinct.

Service clerk scene keeps neutral full sentences and Sie in German; bare balik is anchored as a noun (ang akong balik) in line, example and trophy. Speech trio ugma/balik/bisikleta lacks the required connector/aspect word; kung from the line fixes it without touching the trophy.

Tutor dialogue is coherent (kausa vs kaduha, home study on Thursday); Padayon as bare predicate is natively anchored; wala tay klase is correct existential negation; Magtuon foils and the ubos/gikan/tungod connector foils are impossible.

Friend register with lang and inclusive ta is right; tigom para sa staged productively in 7-10; nakauban/niuban/giubanan and the connector foils are impossible, and the bill-splitting compromise matches the beat.

Agent scene: Sige acceptance of the last week of May, no staff decision asserted; plete foil replaces the plausible Bohol; form and month blanks are clean. Connector absence is justified by the acceptance beat.

Boss scene has palihug and Sie; hinungdan frame now translated as Grund/reason. Two gaps: the 7-10 staging item 'compromise with sige, apan + alternative' is never produced in any learner line, and this beat (you propose dates after she asks shorter) is its natural home; the speech trio hinungdan/hangyo/kasal is three nouns with no connector or aspect word.

Cousin scene recycles kung, inig balik and mo- future with the island/mountain combination; unta stays in the them-line; magpalabay og gabii is idiomatic for staying a night; May gabii pa ta is acceptable existential Cebuano. The English final reply ('on our way back') shifts the timing against inig balik and the German 'nach der Rückkehr'.

findings.issue: Counterpart HIGH on cloze kind coding adjudicated: connector slots here (kung/aron/dayon) admit native alternatives when typed (basta, kon, kay in L6, para in L3, unya in L2), so 'choice' with impossible foils is the correct protection against unjust rejection; no edit.
Transfer example models para + noun purpose (para sa among panihapon) in the 1-3 block where it is recognition-only.

findings.issue: youTwo lacks the connector role; inig before the bare root balik is single-fit when typed (kung/aron/sa/pag cannot precede a bare root), so it is added as a typed connector blank; line unchanged. Foils are all ungrammatical before a bare root.

Adjudication of counterpart receipts: findings 2, 3, 5, 7, 9 and the EN timing in 10 are already resolved in these bytes. Connector slots kung/aron/apan remain 'choice' because typed alternatives (kon, basta, para, pero) are native and must not be rejected; the only truly single-fit typed connector in this path is inig before a bare root (lesson 10). The suggested magpalabay to magpabilin swap conflates an idiomatic overnight verb with a different lexical root and is not adopted; 'May gabii pa ta' is acceptable Cebuano and left unchanged.

Lesson 2: the term 'pamahaw' (breakfast) is stale; nothing in the approved dialogue refers to breakfast. Replace it with a word the learner actually produces in the lesson ('Mouban', the cloze form answer and the opener of the second learner reply) so the term list grounds the exercises.

Lesson 4: the learner's compromise offers to clean the room herself but never links that offer to the newly announced cleaning fee, so the beat reads as a non sequitur and the term 'dugang bayad' (extra fee) is not grounded anywhere in the dialogue. A 12-word reply keeps the 6–12 limit, keeps all three cloze roles (form Magpabilin with cue, choice bulan, single-fit connector kung) and the unchanged line-1 recall/speaking set, and now makes the trade explicit: self-cleaning in exchange for no extra fee. Cloze array replaced in full against its exact old value; the only change is the trailing literal string.
